reason: The identity-vacuum Lax ansatz admits an apparent uniform gauge/endpoint obstruction. Standard spectral Lax matrices often have a NONidentity vacuum; that class was not tested and is not ruled out by the current argument.
candidate: Same finite-range group Lax equation, but L(allzero)=a ranges over conjugacy-class representatives. The allones equation only requires L(allones) conjugate to a, not identity.
gauge: Keep the vacuum loop a and gauge all spatial spanning-tree edges to identity. Exclude the unique normalized connection gauge-equivalent to assigning a to EVERY edge; that carries only background length, not configuration information.
positive_verification: Recover M, verify every original local equation, and exhibit spatial monodromy depending on the row rather than only vacuum/length before making any invariant claim.
negative_scope: Only registered finite groups/window sizes; no statement about all spectral groups or unbounded memory.
